feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 17 September 2026 11:53am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 17 September 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Strong westerly airstream is established today, before Atlantic fronts move across the area tomorrow.


##Wind##

West 5 or 6 for the rest of today and for much of tonight, possibly occasionally 7 in the east of area, then decreasing West or Southwest 4 or 5 around dawn tomorrow. Gradually increasing Southwest 6 tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, occasionally rough in the east of the area until later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then rain in the west of the area later tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in showers or rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Soon increasing Southwest 6 or 7 tomorrow afternoon, occasionally touching gale 8 in a few spots. Then gradually decreasing Southwest 6 during the evening, and West or Southwest 5 or 6 overnight into Saturday.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, becoming moderate or rough for a time.


##Weather##

Rain soon spreading from the west to all waters, clearing later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.
